question_text: The Constitution provides for the creation of autonomous regions in Muslim Mindanao and the Cordilleras. Which of the following is a requirement for the establishment of an autonomous region?

options.text: A majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite held in the affected areas must favor autonomy.
A two-thirds vote of all members of Congress is required to create the region.
The President must issue an executive order declaring the region autonomous.
The Supreme Court must certify that the region is economically viable.
